description.value: C-Lovers Fish & Chips is a well-established BC seafood chain with a location in Horseshoe Bay, a popular cycling hub and BC Ferries terminal. The restaurant specialises in lightly battered fish and chips using multiple species — cod, halibut, haddock, salmon, prawns, and oysters — with both dine-in and takeout available. The chain participates in the Ocean Wise sustainable seafood program, an notable credential for environmentally-minded visitors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the C-Lovers Fish & Chips Horseshoe Bay location at 6640 Royal Ave with phone 604-913-0994, matching OSM tags. The site has a dedicated take-out menu page confirming takeout service, and the take-out menu labels the C-Dog as 'Gluten Friendly.' No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'C Lovers' but the business markets itself as 'C-Lovers Fish & Chips' (missing hyphen and descriptor).
OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but Horseshoe Bay (6640 Royal Ave) is in the District of West Vancouver — possible mis-tagging.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active dine-in and takeout seafood restaurant in Horseshoe Bay, a key BC cycling node and ferry terminal; a useful fuelling stop with confirmed contact details.
enrichment_extras.notes: Chain has 12 locations across BC and Alberta; this record represents the Horseshoe Bay branch only. Ocean Wise sustainable seafood program participant per website navigation.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Take-out menu explicitly labels the C-Dog (deep fried battered beef wiener) as 'Gluten Friendly'; no vegetarian or vegan options are mentioned
